notes.title: Hotfix Patch 1.0.14!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39645897/556c7763a03943a86bb04b58796531077e2e2941.png[/img]

[h1]Hi everyone![/h1]

Thanks to all your feedback and bug reports we've been able to fix a few more issues.

If you would like to report any bugs you encounter of just engage with the community feel free to join us in the [url=https://discord.gg/Dgntp94uFm]Official Community Discord[/url].

The following bugs have been fixed in patch 1.0.14:
[list]
[*]Fixed your Actors sometimes sinking into the floor when you have a custom decor set.
[*]Fixed the player sometimes getting stuck after a tutorial prompt.
[*]Fixed the player sometimes getting stuck when picking up a collectible. (For real this time)
[*]Made the collectible busts a little harder to find.
[*]Fixed the third role displaying in Act 1 despite the play only having two roles.
[*]Fixed being able to time travel by pressing the spacebar.
[*]Fixed some walls fading in places where they shouldn't.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 1.0.11!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39645897/556c7763a03943a86bb04b58796531077e2e2941.png[/img]

[h1]Hey there Actors![/h1]

We hope you've been enjoying the 1.0 release of Melodramatica!

A few bugs popped up here and there so we are coming at you with a quick hotfix to take care of some of the more pressing issues. 

This will most likely be the last patch of the game as our school year is approaching the end.
Do not worry though, we intend to stick around for a bit to interact with the community and to see what awesome shows you'll be performing in-game!

Here's a list of the changes you can expect in version :
[list]
[*] You can no longer walk around when helping your Actors out when they're training.
[*] Actors' text boxes close when you move away from them at the end of a conversation.
[*] The display for crafting progress is now always active as long as you are near the interactable.
[*] Actors now take their time when crafting decor for the stage.
[*] Decor sets now have a nice background to go with the scene.
[*] Some small issues fixed with the loading the selected decor when continuing play.
[*] Picking up the collectibles around the theatre no longer has a chance to get you stuck.
[*] Audio settings are now properly divided into Music and SFX.
[*] Your settings will not persist in between play sessions. (yay)
[*] Some small changes in UI.
[/list]
Thank you once again, we hope to see you on stage!

notes.title: Full Release Patch 1.0!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39645897/bfa6f5f4f165b940f5dcc785a85d07d4195156ec.png[/img]

[h1]Hey there Actors![/h1]

Today is the day of the final release! This project has been in the works for nearly a year and it all led up to this point. As a major milestone, this full release also includes a massive update filled to the brim with fixes & improvements,[i] based on your feedback![/i]

Before we get into the patch notes, we again want to give our heartfelt thanks to you, The Players. We've received so much good feedback and so many suggestions & bug reports, all of which have helped us improve the game immensely.


Now, for those willing to dare our patch notes:

[h3]Major Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Autosaving![/b]. We heard you loud & clear: once you end a day, the game will autosave your progress, allowing you to close the game & later continue playing the next in-game day. Use the "Continue" button on the main menu!
[*] [b]Actor Preview while dressing[/b]. While you're equipping new clothing items to your actors, you can see a preview of that actor in real time.
[*] [b]Additional Story between acts[/b]. Now when you finish an Act, you will see a bit more of the story on what is changing and going on around the theatre.
[*] [b]Options Menu[/b]. You are now able to change various graphics options, mute the audio & disable tutorial prompts.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Starting money decreased, no more buying out the store on Day 1.
[*] Money earned from Plays now reflects the performance of your actors & preparation of the show better.
[*] Amount of skill points Actors get from practicing skills has been adjusted to allow for a more logical result.
[*] Crafting of Clothing & Staging has been made a bit more difficult. It requires more effort to finish it yourself. (Or just send your actors to do it for you)
[/list]

[b]Onboarding[/b]
[list]
[*] Added various prompts to explain parts of the game that were confusing at first.
[*] Improved existing onboarding prompts to better guide the player and show what buttons are being referred to.
[/list]

[b]Narrative[/b]
[list]
[*] Many quests have improved descriptions & show what reward you get for completing them.
[*] All the different plays have their own unique descriptions.
[*] All actors can now tell you a bit more about themselves.
[*] Added actor text lines to the play snapshots when you perform a play. (Now you can get an idea of what they're saying!)
[/list]

[b]UI & Menus[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a credits button to the main menu.
[*] All items in the catalogue now have a description.
[*] Small improvements to Menus around the game, adding small animations & making them feel a bit smoother to use.
[*] Removed the final bit of placeholder UI. (specifically the show overview before you start the play)
[*] Actors now get a small notification icon when they encounter an issue while practicing a skill.
[*] Improved UI while crafting.
[*] You can press the ESC key to close any menu in-game.
[*] When talking to actors, their textboxes now show who you're talking to.
[*] Added a brand new intro splash-screen when booting up the game. (And you can't skip it >:)
[/list]

[b]Art & Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] All the plays now have unique snapshots of scenes related to that play.
[*] Multiple new hats & masks have been added and made available to purchase, craft & equip to your actors.
[*] All available stages have had small improvements.
[*] In-game cursor has been improved to make it a bit more visible & easier to use.
[*] New icons for all the stages.
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*] New audio/sound bits for different actors & actions
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed various small issues with Show Calculation. You should now get the score you deserve
[*] Fixed multiple smaller issues where the show result overview didn't accurately show the actual results.
[*] Fixed an issue where some of the quests didn't register being completed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the first act specifically was not possible to be completed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player would sometimes keep walking when opening a menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where some crafting menus required you to click objects, while others required you to drag 'n drop. (It's all drag 'n drop now)
[*] Fixed various issues surround conflicts, no more softlocks, resolution bugs or inability to fix.
[*] Fixed an issue where you would help an actor with a conflict but they give you a hostile response.
[*] Fixed a bug where the audio notification wouldn't play when an actor ran into an issue.
[*] Fixed a bug where you would still be on the same day after performing a play. The date now progresses and the Store + Actor AP gets reset.
[*] Fixed an issue where the attitudes of Actors while talking to them after finishing an Act does not reflect the choices you made for them.
[*] Fixed a bug where the date could go to 32nd of March and beyond.
[*] Fixed a bug where actors that weren't assigned to plays would sometimes randomly walk through the play while it's happening.
[/list]


You made it to the end, be proud of yourself! <3
Thanks for reading and once again thanks for playing our game, we hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.title: Early Access 0.3.3 - Improvements & fixes all around! Also a small thank you!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there Actors![/h2]

Before we get into the patch notes, we here at Team Actors want to thank all of you for playing and giving us feedback so far. We've received such kind words as well as clear feedback on what to improve and we couldn't be more grateful!

We are evaluating all the feedback we get, here on Steam, sent in-game through the feedback tool, in our community discord and elsewhere. It's helping us a ton with refining our priorities and making sure we work on the most important issues first.

[b]Know that we hear you loud and clear: Saving & Loading is coming next week![/b] This is a particular issue that was brought up numerous times & we have bumped it up to the list of highest priority tasks!


[h2]Now for the patch notes[/h2]

[h3]New Additions:[/h3]
- It is now possible to navigate all interaction with Actors using your keyboard
(E to interact/select, W and S to go up and down the interaction menus)

- New minimap + new icons for actors

- When you hover over items in crafting menus, you can see additional info


[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
- Parts of the HUD have been improved & tidied up, with new animations & scaling improvements

- Interaction with actors has been tidied up and all the crafting jobs have been put in their own little sub-section

- You no longer have to chase your actors to try and talk to them, when you approach them, they will wait for you

- Décor changing interactable has received a "subtle" improvement to make it more visible

- Collision around the map has been improved & clarified a bit more (now featuring all new fences to block your path!)

- Wood workshop has been cleaned up

- The fading of items & walls has gotten a pass to make it more consistent and comfortable

- Startup menu buttons centered & it now tells you to press any button (we recommend the Y key)


[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
- Actors no longer run away while talking to them
- Player character no longer keeps walking while selecting items to craft
- (Spot)lights have been turned on
- Actors no longer randomly walk across the stage while the play is happening
- The camera to see the play happening has gotten it's front row seat back
- You are no longer required to resolve a conflict in 3 seconds, it now pauses the timer.
- Small animation fixes
- Conflicts work correctly and actors will actually let you fully solve them
- UI no longer randomly becomes uninteractable
- Actors can have more than 1 conflict in their lifetime
- Minimap now hides behind crafting UI where it belongs
- Switching between actors in the play overview no longer breaks when you switch left


There is still plenty of work to be done and we already have more improvements & fixes in the work, so look out for another update next week!
